T01: Empty workspaces report zero membership/storage with no invented metadata, while unknown workspaces are rejected.
T02: One read-only snapshot aggregates active owned heads and exact-version references, excludes foreign/deleted cards, deduplicates shared storage/tags, and distinguishes known content coverage, forks and observed chat copies.
T03: Reference-only membership does not create owned cards or asset records, known zero measurements remain distinct from unknown values, and top breakdowns are deterministic and bounded to twelve.
T04: Storage aggregates exclude permanent retirement records and do not claim to measure physical disk space.
